advice: Physiotherapy for joints in linear morphea. Monthly CBC, LFT on methotrexate; no alcohol. Baseline CBC, LFT, RFT, HBsAg/anti-HCV before methotrexate. Methotrexate is taken ONCE A WEEK only. Avoid pregnancy (women and men) during and for 3 months after; no cotrimoxazole. Children: 0.3–1 mg/kg once weekly (max 25 mg).
